svg.title: Where my pull requests landed
svg.desc: An isometric city with one building per repository and one floor per merged pull request, grouped into company districts. Microsoft: onnxscript 6, kiota 5, debugpy 2, playwright 2, typespec 2, azure-sdk-for-js 1, mssql-python 1, vscode-cmake-tools 1; Meta: lexical 10, stylex 2; AWS: mcp 1, mcp-proxy-for-aws 1, sagemaker-python-sdk 1; Cloudflare: workers-sdk 3; Apple: coremltools 2; Tesla: fixed-containers 1.
